<script setup lang="ts">
// Slices are { name, value }; outside labels show the name and the share,
// legend clicks hide / show a slice.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { PieChart } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: ["Search", "Direct", "Social", "Email", "Referral"],
  zh: ["搜索", "直接访问", "社交媒体", "邮件", "推荐"],
  ja: ["検索", "ダイレクト", "ソーシャル", "メール", "参照元"],
  fr: ["Recherche", "Direct", "Réseaux sociaux", "E-mail", "Référents"],
};

const { language } = useI18n();
const data = computed(() =>
  [1048, 735, 580, 484, 300].map((value, i) => ({
    name: (TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en)[i],
    value,
  })),
);
</script>

<template>
  <PieChart :data="data" :height="300" />
</template>

translationResources.title: Pie / donut chart
translationResources.description: Parts of a whole: pie, donut (with a total in the hole) and Nightingale rose. Use them for a few categories (up to ~8) whose shares matter more than exact comparisons. Hover or use the arrow keys to highlight a slice, Esc clears; click a legend item to hide a slice.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Outside labels with leader lines show the name and the share; onClick (or Enter on the highlighted slice) reports the selected source.

donut.title: Donut with a total
donut.description: centerValue and centerLabel write the total in the hole; onHover replaces it with the hovered plan, so the tooltip is turned off. legend.toggle is false so the total always matches the visible slices.

rose.title: Nightingale rose
rose.description: rose makes the radius (not the angle) show the value: good for cyclic data such as months. padAngle, cornerRadius and a small innerRadius soften the shape; each datum's color marks its season.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: labels places the labels outside (with leader lines), inside the slices or nowhere; labelContent combines the name, the value and the percent.

market-share.title: Market share with “Others”
market-share.description: The long tail of small vendors is summed into an “Others” slice in a neutral color, so the donut keeps a handful of readable slices; the hole shows the total.

nested.title: Nested rings
nested.description: Two charts stacked: a PieChart of the categories sits in the hole of a DonutChart of their items (a clip-path circle leaves the ring hoverable), and the items take lighter shades of their category color.

small-multiples.title: Small multiples
small-multiples.description: One small donut per region with the same colors and order, so a single legend serves them all and the regions compare at a glance.

portfolio.title: Investment portfolio with filter tags
portfolio.description: The tags above the chart and the legend edit the same controlled hidden list through onToggle, and Show all clears it. centerValue sums the asset classes shown, and renderTooltip gives each slice's share of the whole portfolio, not only of the visible slices.

live-poll.title: Live poll
live-poll.description: New votes arrive every second (setInterval, cleared on unmount or pause) and the slices animate toward the new shares. renderTooltip shows the votes, centerValue the running total, and only a change of leader is announced to screen readers.

drill-down.title: Drill-down into a cloud bill
drill-down.description: Clicking a category (onClick) replaces the data with its services; the breadcrumb goes back to the overview. The tooltip hints at the click, and the line under the chart describes the selected category or service.

survey-quarters.title: Satisfaction survey by quarter
survey-quarters.description: A diverging red-to-green scale set through each datum's color, with startAngle={-90} so the happy answers come first. Picking another quarter animates the slices; the center shows the CSAT and the line below its change from the previous quarter.

ShapeChartCommonProps.height: Height of the chart, legend included; numbers are pixels
ShapeChartCommonProps.width: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels
ShapeChartCommonProps.renderer: Backend of the shapes: auto tries WebGPU, WebGL2, WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; the text is always drawn with Canvas2D, above the shapes. Defaults to the global default (setDefaultChartRenderer)
ShapeChartCommonProps.palette: Colors of the marks without a color (defaults to the --chart-series-1..8 CSS variables, then the theme colors)
ShapeChartCommonProps.legend: Shows the legend, or sets its position and whether clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage or series
ShapeChartCommonProps.tooltip: Tooltip; false disables it, an object can render its content
ShapeChartCommonProps.format: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip
ShapeChartCommonProps.animation: Entry and update animations (skipped when the user prefers reduced motion)
ShapeChartCommonProps.padding: Space around the drawing, in pixels
ShapeChartCommonProps.onHover: Called when the hovered (or keyboard-highlighted) mark changes; null when nothing is highlighted
ShapeChartCommonProps.onClick: Called when a mark is clicked, tapped or activated with Enter
ShapeChartCommonProps.renderTooltip: React content of the tooltip (replaces the default content)
ShapeChartCommonProps.className: Additional class name of the root element
ShapeChartCommonProps.style: Inline styles of the root element
ShapeChartCommonProps.ref: Imperative handle: getInstance() returns the engine instance (toggle, resize...)
ShapeChartCommonProps.percentFormat: Formats the shares (labels, tooltip); one decimal by default (`40.0%`)
ShapeChartCommonProps.locale: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, number and percent formats, calendar dates); built-in texts in English, Chinese, Japanese and French. Defaults to the page language (`<html lang>`), then the browser language
ShapeChartCommonProps.texts: Replaces built-in texts of the locale (tooltip rows such as `value`, `share`, `conversion`, accessible names such as `pieChart`, the `noData` placeholder); `{name}`, `{label}` and `{index}` are replaced
ShapeChartCommonProps.hidden: Indexes of the hidden slices / stages / series (controlled); legend clicks then only call `onToggle`
ShapeChartCommonProps.onToggle: Called when a legend item is clicked, with the index and the hidden indexes

ShapeDatum.name: Name shown in the legend, the labels and the tooltip
ShapeDatum.color: Color (any CSS color, var(--x) included); taken from the palette when omitted

ShapeHoverEvent.index: Index of the slice, stage, series or leaf (treemap: in the flattened leaves)
ShapeHoverEvent.indicator: Radar: index of the indicator closest to the pointer
ShapeHoverEvent.name: Name of the mark
ShapeHoverEvent.value: Value of the mark (radar: value of the indicator)
ShapeHoverEvent.percent: Share from 0 to 1 (pie: of the visible total, funnel: of the first stage, treemap: of the root, gauge: of the range)
ShapeHoverEvent.color: Resolved CSS color of the mark
ShapeHoverEvent.path: Treemap: names from the root to the leaf
ShapeHoverEvent.date: Calendar heatmap: day of the cell, YYYY-MM-DD
ShapeHoverEvent.source: Sankey / chord: source node or group of the hovered link or ribbon
ShapeHoverEvent.target: Sankey / chord: target node or group of the hovered link or ribbon
ShapeHoverEvent.reverseValue: Chord: flow from the target back to the source of the hovered ribbon

ShapeTooltipOptions.render: Renders the tooltip content (a string is set as text, a DOM node is inserted)
